read.thesis: Brazil channel overhang and generic pricing cut FY26 operating EBITDA to $1.1B–$1.125B from $1.3B; ex-Brazil volumes grew and new products rose 20%, but Q4 EBITDA is guided to about half of 2025.

capex.quote: Our CapEx is generally going to be aligned to what we said on a run rate basis in our September comments around $200 million a year.

triggers.label: FY26 EBITDA $1.3B → $1.1–1.125B
triggers.quote: Today, we are updating that estimate to a range of $1.1 billion to $1.125 billion for the full year.

triggers.label: Brazil channel overhang ~$250M
triggers.quote: we think we had roughly $250 million of revenue more in 2020 -- coming out of 2025 growing season

triggers.label: Pricing down high single digits in Q4
triggers.quote: we got pricing in the fourth quarter that's implied to be down high single digits.

triggers.label: Brazil sellout down ~12% YTD
triggers.quote: the sellout market in Brazil is down roughly 12%, which would be the equivalent of $1 billion.

triggers.label: New products +20% volume
triggers.quote: New product volumes grew 20% in the quarter with growth in every region

guidance.quote: Today, we are updating that estimate to a range of $1.1 billion to $1.125 billion for the full year.
we expect full year to be in the range of $0.76 to $0.80 per share
with operating EBITDA margin of about 15% for the year
We expect still to be close to about $1.5 billion in terms of our cash position by the end of the year.
It's aligned to, call it, around $1 billion of financial debt that we're targeting by year-end
But I do expect us to grow in '27.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we estimated 2026 stand-alone operating EBITDA of about $1.3 billion.
with operating EBITDA margin of about 15% for the year

red_flags.label: Brazil channel stuffing: ~$250M overhang from 2025 sell-in
red_flags.quote: too much of the product we sold into the Brazil channel last year didn't go to ground.

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA ~half of 2025
red_flags.quote: This would imply a fourth quarter EBITDA that is now expected to be about half of 2025 levels

red_flags.label: Buybacks precluded until 2027 by spin tax representations
red_flags.quote: just don't have the ability to buy back in the fourth quarter

evasions.topic: Q3 cash bridge ($3.1B pro forma Q2 to $1.8B Q3)
evasions.quote: I don't want to get too much into the pro forma Q2 to Q3.
So the question that you just asked me has been asked of the team, okay?
